response:
{
  "cypher": "MATCH (bh:Player {name: "Buddy Hield"})-[:receivesAward]->(aw:Award)
WITH collect(aw) AS buddyAwards
MATCH (p:Player)-[:receivesAward]->(aw2:Award)
WHERE p <> bh AND aw2 IN buddyAwards
RETURN p.name AS playerName, count(DISTINCT aw2) AS awardCount
ORDER BY awardCount DESC"
  ,
  "rationale": "The query first gathers all awards received by Buddy Hield, then finds other players who have received any of those same awards, counts the distinct awards each of those players has received, and returns the player names with the corresponding counts."
}

WITH count(DISTINCT player) AS playerCount 
RETURN playerCount"

}

response:
{
  "cypher": "MATCH (a:Player {name: "Aron Baynes"})-[:playsFor]->(t:Team)
MATCH (p:Player)-[:playsFor]->(t)
WHERE p <> a
RETURN p.name AS player, count(DISTINCT t) AS teamCount
ORDER BY teamCount DESC"
